parts.label: a
parts.technique: Calculating Scs and Sss (components of PMCC formula)
parts.reason: These sums are calculated purely as a step toward the product moment correlation coefficient formula in part (b); S5.1 explicitly excludes use of the PMCC formula, and this calculation is inseparable from that excluded method.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Product moment correlation coefficient via formula
parts.reason: S5.1 explicitly states 'use of the formula is not required' for PMCC, and S2.2/S5.1 exclude calculations involving PMCC formula.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Interpretation of PMCC result
parts.reason: This part uses the numerical answer from the excluded part (b), so per the rule about parts depending on out-of-spec answers, it is out.

parts.label: d

parts.label: e

parts.reason: S2.2 guidance explicitly mentions 'the dangers of extrapolation'; this part is a conceptual comment about extrapolating beyond the data range (t=39 outside range 10-27) and does not require using the excluded regression equation's numeric output.

parts.label: b

parts.reason: This part relies on the values of a and b obtained in part (a), which was solved using an excluded technique (mean of discrete r.v.), so it is out per the dependency rule.

parts.label: c

parts.reason: Depends on the CDF values from part (b), which itself depends on the excluded part (a).

parts.reason: S4.1 explicitly excludes calculation of variance of discrete random variables.
